question: An uncle is 6 times as old as his nephew. In 6 years, the difference in their ages will be 30 years. What is the sum of their current ages (in years)?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of Uncle : Nephew = 6 : 1.

Age difference is always constant → 30 years.

Difference in ratio units = 6 − 1 = 5 units.

5 units = 30 years ⇒ 1 unit = 6 years.

Sum of current ages = 6 + 1 = 7 units = 7 × 6 = 42 years.

**∴ The correct option is A.**
